title: 日本ダービーの後に・その瞳には何が

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Neither Narita Taishin nor Winning Ticket manage to conquer the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite having her dream crushed, Winning Ticket is still looking forward to the next race, and Narita Taishin is left deeply impressed by such determination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin reaffirms her dedication to keep pushing on, so she can seize victory at the final race of the Triple Crown tour—the Kikuka Sho.
